title: Vanishing of the completed formal graph discrepancy
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], J a quasi-coherent ideal, and P,F,Fprime coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Use the completion and quotient constructions of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let p:P→F, q:P→Fprime, g:Fhat→Phat and theta:Fhat→Fprimehat satisfy g followed by phat=id and g followed by qhat=theta. For n≥0 put Q=Fprime/J^(n+1)Fprime, t=theta_n, and d=q followed by the quotient projection minus p followed by the quotient projection followed by t. Then g followed by the completed d is zero.

proof.text: The quotient Q is coherent and killed by J^(n+1). Every quotient Q/J^(m+1)Q inherits this annihilation: apply idealModuleProduct_quotient_comp_zero_iff to its epimorphic quotient projection and use the zero ideal-product inclusion of Q. Thus the completion of Q is uniformly annihilated by J^(n+1).

Cancel the epimorphic quotient projection of P to identify the level-n reduction of d with the reduction of q followed by Q→Q/J^(n+1)Q minus the reduction of p followed by t and that same projection. Evaluating the two projection equations for g at n makes these terms equal. Hence the completed discrepancy vanishes at n.

Uniform annihilation makes all target transitions from levels m≥n to n invertible by formalModule_annihilated_power_iff. Naturality propagates the zero component upward by canceling these monomorphisms. For m<n cancel the epimorphic source transition from n to m, using formalTransition_epi. Extensionality of natural transformations gives the desired zero map.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0889(1), completed discrepancy calculation; proved in second reading using quotient annihilation, stabilization and formalTransition_epi

lean.statement:
theorem formalGraph_discrepancy_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    {F F' : CoherentModules X} {P : CoherentModules X}
    (p : P ⟶ F) (q : P ⟶ F')
    (g : (completion X J).obj F ⟶ (completion X J).obj P)
    (θ : (completion X J).obj F ⟶ (completion X J).obj F')
    (hp : g ≫ (completion X J).map p = 𝟙 _)
    (hq : g ≫ (completion X J).map q = θ) (n : ℕ) :
    let Q : CoherentModules X := ⟨formalModuleQuotient J (n + 1) F'.obj,
      (formalCompletionSystem_coherent J F').1 n⟩
    let t : formalModuleQuotient J (n + 1) F.obj ⟶
        formalModuleQuotient J (n + 1) F'.obj := θ.hom.app (op n)
    let d : P ⟶ Q := ObjectProperty.homMk
      (q.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F'.obj -
        p.hom ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) F.obj ≫ t)
    g ≫ (completion X J).map d = 0
